children: AIBiotics Therapies had no revenue in the quarter, unchanged from a year earlier, while its net loss narrowed 46.7%. Lower general and administrative expenses, including reduced consulting, legal and professional, and advertising and marketing costs, drove the improvement; a gain on extinguishment of liabilities also contributed.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “NET LOSS”. ³ Reported as “NET LOSS PER SHARE – BASIC AND DILUTED”.
: Fell 37.3% to $301,327, primarily as consulting fees declined $130,076, legal and professional fees fell $31,736, and advertising and marketing decreased $17,000.
: Shifted to $18,914 from $49,557 of expense, reflecting a $61,753 gain on extinguishment and no repeat of the prior-year $38,403 loss, partly offset by higher interest expense.
: Cash was $223,074 at September 30, 2026, and working capital deficit was $4,906,285; management said it plans to fund operations with cash on hand and additional financing.
: The company said its recurring losses, negative operating cash flows and working capital deficit raise substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
